items.label: Connect 3 Devices Simultaneously
items.value: This Bluetooth keyboard features 3 Bluetooth channels, allowing you to connect up to 3 devices at once. You can easily switch between devices, and control your tablet, computer, TV, and phone with a single keyboard. Bluetooth 5.3 ensures a stable and reliable connection with a range of up to 10 meters

items.label: Ultra Slim and Portable Keyboard
items.value: The Inateck Bluetooth keyboard is just 0.2 inches thick and weighs only 228g, making it extremely lightweight and portable. It’s the perfect Bluetooth keyboard for travels and business trips

items.label: Comfortable Typing Experience
items.value: The keyboard comes with a larger, more precise touchpad without lags. The first row features dedicated shortcut keys for one-touch access to shortcut functions. The non-slip bottom feet design ensures stable typing without movement, providing you with a typing experience similar to that of a laptop

items.label: Compatible with Windows and iPad OS
items.value: Our Bluetooth keyboard is fully compatible with Windows and iPad OS, allowing you to use it with desktops, laptops, iPad, iPad Pro, iPad Air, and iPad Mini

items.label: Built to Last
items.value: The keys of our Bluetooth keyboard are rated for over 5 million keystrokes. With a full charge, the standby time can last up to 150 days, reducing battery anxiety while traveling.

items: Compact Yet Comfortable Size – Perfectly balanced dimensions (9.85" L x 7.11" W x 0.28" H) offer a spacious typing area in a travel-friendly form factor – ideal for on-the-go use with laptops, tablets, iPads, or smartphones.
